## Real-Time Calendar Availability

Voice-optimized availability workflow for a Spanish-speaking AI assistant.

The workflow receives a date and time preference from Vapi, validates the request, generates timezone-aware candidate slots, checks Google Calendar and returns a maximum of three available options.

Core integrations:
• Vapi
• n8n
• Google Calendar

Business hours, appointment duration, timezone and scheduling rules can be adapted without redesigning the complete voice agent.

## 1. Availability Request Intake

The workflow receives a structured consultar_disponibilidad tool call from Vapi.

It extracts the tool call ID, requested date and time preference while supporting different Vapi payload formats.

The request is normalized into a consistent internal structure before any calendar operation is performed.

## 2. Business Rule Validation

The requested date is validated before generating appointment options.

The validation layer checks the YYYY-MM-DD format, prevents past dates, rejects weekends and applies the Europe/Madrid timezone.

Invalid requests are stopped before reaching Google Calendar, reducing unnecessary API operations.

## 3. Invalid Request Recovery

If the date or request is invalid, the workflow returns a structured invalid_request response to Vapi.

The response includes the specific validation reasons and instructs the voice assistant to request another valid date.

The user receives a natural explanation instead of a generic technical error.

## 4. Timezone-Aware Candidate Generation

The workflow generates 30-minute appointment candidates inside the configured business hours.

The requested morning, afternoon or flexible preference determines which scheduling window is used.

Each local Europe/Madrid slot is converted into UTC before being checked against Google Calendar.

## 5. Empty Candidate Handling

If no valid candidate slots can be generated for the requested date or time preference, the workflow stops safely.

A structured response is returned to Vapi so the assistant can request another date or scheduling preference.

No unnecessary Calendar request is performed on this branch.

## 6. Live Google Calendar Availability

Every generated candidate is checked against the connected Google Calendar.

The workflow identifies which 30-minute periods are free without creating or modifying any event.

This separates availability discovery from appointment creation and keeps the consultation process read-only.

## 7. Voice-Optimized Option Selection

Available slots are filtered and a maximum of three options are selected across the requested time window.

Returning a limited and distributed set of options creates a clearer voice conversation than reading every available slot.

If no slot is free, Vapi receives a no_availability response and asks the user for another date or preference.

## 8. Structured Vapi Response

The final response preserves the original Vapi tool call ID and returns the date, timezone, appointment duration and available time slots.

Vapi can read these options naturally, wait for the user to choose one and only then call the separate reservar_cita workflow.

Availability is never treated as a confirmed booking.
